title: Public Assistance: complete source, mapped customer review and independent receiving

task.name: Commission the customer's recurring Public Assistance portfolio and mapped exchange
task.purpose: Turn complete authorized Public Assistance source editions and the customer's actual target schema into a useful reviewed project register, retained customer decisions and independently maintainable receiving workflow.
task.request: Select the original commercial Workshare, accountable analyst and useful disaster/applicant/project scope. Receive complete original public source responses, field definitions, acquisition scope and dates through the maintained OpenFEMA application. Select the complete portfolio and original version, review the actual customer target schema and all mapped fields, then retain the native mapping review. Export the full selected project delivery and complete workspace. The recipient opens the entire register and source, records its actual review or unfinished preparation in the original standalone editor when available, and returns its complete CSV. Reconcile that return through the original application, inspect unmatched identities and changed source cells, and explicitly select valid analyst decisions for apply against the current portfolio version. Reissue the customer's complete delivery and compare the original/current editions. Independently restore the full workspace and continue the same work. Use the exact resulting archive and delivery identity for this Installation preparation.
task.completeOutput: Every original source response, metadata and field dictionary; complete source and portfolio editions; actual target schema, mapping and native review; full target CSV, original source-bound delivery manifest and report; optional complete original customer file and reconciliation; issued recipient editor/project and its actual availability result; complete native workspace and all request/history records. The commissioning directory carries the exact workspace ZIP and selected delivery ZIP plus every customer member, original native Installation seed, explicit operator bindings, selected profile, optional complete working attachments, source annex, native preview/input and full Workorder. Existing commercial phases and acceptance remain in the original case.
task.repeatTrigger: A genuinely later useful source edition, agreed reporting interval, changed customer schema or customer review triggers the next task. Compare complete editions and retain the preceding source, mappings, raw customer files and analyst decisions. An empty public cohort, unchanged portfolio or returned file with no eligible changes retains that actual outcome. Resume an interrupted original source, review, delivery or archive request before creating a distinct operation.
task.pricedUnit: Keep the original merchant resource/page/dataset terms and aggregate buyer authorization. Project rows, FEMA obligations, source pages, downloads and analyst decisions are distinct from qualifying purchases. The customer's professional implementation fee, support and hosting remain in its original Workshare. Select network, asset, recipient, exact atomic unit price, useful-task unit count, budget and facilitators from the existing approved deployment and original financial records.

source.population: The complete acquired OpenFEMA source scope and selected portfolio retained in the original native archive. Preserve declaration/applicant/project dataset versions, filters, acquisition dates, complete response bytes and original row identities. The published funded-project dataset is not a census of all damage, applications or pre-obligation work. Retain zero-row and incomplete acquisition distinctions.
source.meaning: Keep source project identity and customer target key distinct. Project cost, federal obligation, total obligation and mitigation amounts retain their separate USD meanings and exact native representations; never add them into a single funding total. Missing, null, zero and source conflicts remain separate. Keep customer-only/pre-obligation rows and changed source cells in reconciliation for explicit review. Customer annotations and review status are operator decisions, not FEMA eligibility, procurement approval or payment evidence.
source.changePolicy: The customer selects useful scope, target mapping, recipient preparation and explicit accepted review. New source editions or target definitions are reviewed through the original versioned mapping and current-portfolio checks. Retain prior source, customer files, pending native requests and result history. Withdrawal, source-use rights and merchant terms remain with their original accountable owners; independent receiving preserves already acquired material under its actual terms.

receiving.application: The maintained OpenFEMA Public Assistance portfolios application, original CLI/Applications and typed merchant tools; complete native archive inspector/restore and original customer delivery/recipient workflow. The existing SF47 Customer installations desk receives the exact prepared native input.
receiving.acceptanceRule: Open the actual full source/portfolio and mapped customer register, inspect all amount bases and source scope, and use the selected target schema. Reopen the issued recipient editor when its availability is AVAILABLE, retain a useful analyst decision and complete working file, receive the full returned CSV through original reconciliation, inspect all source differences and explicitly apply only accepted analyst proposals. Reissue/compare the original delivery, receive every complete outgoing file, restore the native archive into a distinct private directory and continue the same customer record. The producer views the actual normal/narrow product and every applicable attachment; the named receiving operator records actual outcomes in the existing Installation checks.
receiving.changeAndWithdraw: The customer and authorized receiving analyst control mapping meaning and deliberate decisions. The source/merchant owner controls source publication and terms; independent buyer signing and spending remain with the original buyer/facilitator. Preparing or reopening this source package makes no purchase or new source acquisition and does not mark native checks accepted.
receiving.recovery: Keep the original workspace UUID, archive SHA, selected delivery/version/mapping/review identities and every complete file. Original pending requests remain with the native application. The commissioning preparer uses one private lease and create-only original inputs/outputs; resume with the same directory, request and bytes. Reopen the full package without the producer path. Restore the original workspace using its maintained archive receiver into a new directory. Changed source or bindings get a separate preparation edition; preserve and continue any already saved Installation through its original current draft.
receiving.maintenance: Name the source/merchant owner, customer analyst, target-system maintainer, independent buyer and receiving engineer. Retain actual source-use authority, deployed application/source revision, private configuration references, selected schema, review cadence, whole-task budget, backup/restore procedure and support responsibility. Original customer phases, fees, grant assignment and professional conclusions remain with their actual owners.

steps.title: Select the original customer Workshare and complete task
steps.result: Receive its full commercial source, phases, effort, original fee/payment milestones and existing acceptance checks. Select the useful recurring cohort and customer target without substituting a new commercial plan.

steps.title: Receive the complete original public source and scope
steps.result: Retain complete responses, schema/metadata, exact scope, actual acquisition dates and row identities. Review the selected portfolio, distinct amount bases, conflicts and any empty or incomplete results.

steps.title: Review the real customer schema and mapping
steps.result: Receive the full target definition. Select exact customer keys, source fields, review fields and conversion meanings. Save the original mapping review before native delivery.

steps.title: Operate the complete customer exchange
steps.result: Open all issued customer files and standalone recipient where available. Save complete unfinished preparation and named editions; return the actual CSV to the original native reconciliation. Inspect source differences and unmatched rows before selecting valid analyst decisions.

steps.title: Reissue and compare the next customer delivery
steps.result: Preserve original source values, earlier delivery and customer return. Apply accepted decisions against the current original portfolio, retain the exact resulting version, then reissue and compare through the original native operations.

steps.title: Receive and reopen the whole native project
steps.result: Export the complete current workspace, select its exact retained delivery and receive every source/member. Restore with the maintained original archive API into a distinct receiving directory and reopen source, mapping, decisions and operation history.

steps.title: Prepare and save the original Customer Installation
steps.result: Bind this exact whole source to the fresh original native seed and Workshare with explicit deployment/payment/receiving selections. Independently reopen the preparation; load and preview the native input in the same case, preserving original phases and OPEN acceptance checks.

steps.title: Operate the outgoing handover and maintain it
steps.result: The producing engineer opens/uses the exact application, full archives and applicable reports at normal/narrow widths, views every captured frame and repairs real defects. Deliver complete source, private configuration references, working files and both original application/Installation handovers to the named receiving engineer.

inputs: Complete original commercial Workshare, commissioning source and packet, same case and pinned plan, native phases/effort/fees/checks
Complete original native OpenFEMA workspace ZIP and its SHA-256; actual selected retained project-delivery ID
Actual source authority, disaster/applicant/project scope, complete public responses and native source/portfolio versions
Full customer target definition, selected mapping/native review, original customer CSV/reconciliation and accepted analyst decisions
Complete selected project ZIP including every issued recipient file or actual capacity-specific availability, plus any full additional working files explicitly selected
Fresh original installation-workshare-seed, explicit existing deployment/buyer/payment/source/receiving bindings and actual named operator
Original installed source/runtime and independent receiving directory; complete native reopen/restore and viewed customer-file outcomes
